verified.actualCreation: Company/laboratory v0 compiler and original canonical Team/Entity/Participant/Session/private Channel bootstrap. Real HR Agent emits task/create using simulation_observe/stage/submit with recorded ordinary wake input. Actual Team task pending, original creator ID/revision, proposedOwnerId and lease absent, attemptHistory empty. No writer.accept/submitDecision shortcut or fabricated Team projection.
verified.barrier: Real HR communication/post to canonical director via original private Channel. ctx.teams.postChannelEnvelope actual IO completes before fixture holds return; Team pending Envelope exists but Native outbox receipt remains absent. Run pause succeeds while IO is held.
verified.coverage: Native-only result complete=false/status native-only. Connection report collects actual original Team/task and pending delivery books; covered denotes source coverage, not departure permission. Sender task creator metadata and current role refs; sender Native outbox is outcome-unknown, both selected persons expose matching Native messages with outcome-unknown and actual channel-delivery Envelope/recipient/sequence references with outgoing/incoming directions.
verified.noWrites: Original Native revision, Team cursor, every original Channel cursor and original materialized/unmaterialized Session persistence sequence/revision/fingerprint are identical around all reads. Query calls add zero model requests; no claim/ack/consume/cancel/assign/role change. Existing live Sessions are explicitly flushed before capturing the held baseline, outside inspection.
verified.privateMetadata: No task/description/message/Persona body in reports. Task/message private canaries come from actual accepted Agent effects; unique Persona name is explicitly declared as one allowed finite trusted catalog option before strict compilation, then selected by author input. Public reference relation subject IDs remain allowed.
verified.bounds: Real Chinese initial responsibility relation and ID cause UTF8 JSON byte count > character count. Actual covered report passes exact item limit and +1, lower limit overflows; exact full UTF8 byte limit and +1 pass, byte-1/character count overflows and complete=false; complete overflow envelope fits request bound. No partial report is interpreted as all clear.
verified.selectors: Actual person/assignment selectors preserve responsibilities; unknown person, stale person revision, unknown selector kind and too-small minimal report envelope are rejected with original parser/owner checks.
verified.reconciliationAndCold: Release original post return; original dispatch records its real receipt without repeating IO. Pause retained, explicit completed checkpoint. New process restores paused, no model calls; queries current actual metadata, original task/creator/revision and original Native operation/Envelope/identity refs. Compares retained current responsibilities after checkpoint, not the earlier held pending snapshot.
verified.identity: Canonical sender/receiver bindings, original sender Persona and original private Channel IDs retained across actual process restoration.
